units.source_text: 这新来之客，正是日夜思念玉鬘而悲伤哭泣的右近！

en.t: This newly arrived visitor was none other than Ukon, who had wept in sorrow day and night while longing for Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 右近在源氏公子家当了十几年侍女，常叹自身乃中途参加，毕竟不甚合适。

en.t: Ukon had served as a lady-in-waiting in Prince Genji's household for more than ten years, yet she often lamented that, having joined midway, she never quite belonged there.

units.source_text: 巴望找到小女主人玉鬘，可得终身归宿。

en.t: She longed to find her young mistress Tamakazura, believing that then she would have a place to belong for the rest of her life.

units.source_text: 因此常常到这长谷寺来拜求观音菩萨。

en.t: For that reason she often came to this Hase Temple to pray to the bodhisattva Kannon.

units.source_text: 她是常来之客，一切都很熟悉。

en.t: She was a frequent visitor and knew everything there very well.

units.source_text: 只因徒步而来，不堪困疲，暂时躺着歇息。

en.t: But because she had come on foot and was overcome with exhaustion, she had lain down for a while to rest.

units.source_text: 此时丰后介走到邻室的帐幕前面来，亲自捧着食器盘，替女主人送膳。

en.t: Just then Bungo no Suke came to the curtain before the neighboring room, personally carrying a tray of dishes to serve his lady.

units.source_text: 他向帐幕内说：“请小姐用膳。

en.t: Facing the inside of the curtain, he said, "My lady, please take your meal.

units.source_text: 伙食很不周全，甚是失礼。”

en.t: The food is poorly prepared, and I must humbly apologize for the discourtesy."

units.source_text: 右近听了他这话，知道住在里面的不是与自己同等的人，而是个贵妇人。

en.t: Hearing these words, Ukon realized that the person inside was not someone of her own rank, but a noble lady.

units.source_text: 她就向门缝里窥探，但觉这男子的面貌似乎曾经见过，然而记不起是谁。

en.t: She peered through a crack in the door and felt that she had seen the man's face before, but she could not remember who he was.

units.source_text: 从前她看见丰后介时，丰后介年纪还很小。

en.t: When she had seen Bungo no Suke long ago, he had still been very young.

units.source_text: 如今他已长得很胖，肤色黝黑，风尘满面。

en.t: Now he had grown quite stout, his complexion was dark, and his face was weathered from travel.

units.source_text: 二十年不见，当然一时认不得了。

en.t: After not seeing him for twenty years, it was only natural that she could not recognize him at once.
